taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: SAML artifact resolution binding to issuer, recipient and transaction
controls.source_trace: Trace the opaque artifact through the trusted back channel to the assertion actually consumed, including requester identity and InResponseTo/recipient checks.
controls.implementation_branch: Keep artifact source, authenticated resolving SP and the returned assertion transaction linked. Artifact possession alone need not authorize an unrelated resolver. Inspect the consumed assertion recipient/correlation after resolution; successful back-channel TLS by itself does not prove the correct assertion was selected.
controls.operational_method: Parse the supported artifact type and its source/index under the actual SAML binding before choosing the resolver. Bind the artifact, authenticated resolving SP and returned assertion to the same transaction/recipient. Retain one-use/expiry state separately from back-channel TLS. An opaque handle lookup stub cannot establish SAML source selection unless it preserves the actual artifact and resolver identity rules.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned SP transactions in a local federation fixture and compare rightful artifact resolution with swapped requester or replay.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Opaque artifact syntax does not prove confidentiality or correct binding; failure at transport authentication must not be called assertion replay protection.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind artifact, SP and transaction and enforce intended reuse semantics; retest normal resolution and substitution denial.
